{
  "summary": "The function fn_11 computes a 32-bit hash value based on the input buffer 'in' of length 'len', using a specific algorithm. It does not modify the input buffer and does not write to the output buffer. The result is returned as a 64-bit unsigned integer.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_11",
  "algorithm": "custom hash",
  "self_confidence": 1.0,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "claim_1",
      "type": "ALG",
      "text": "Implements a custom hash algorithm.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_2",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Uses a for loop to iterate over the input buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_3",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not write to out.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_4",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the hash value when the input length is valid.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_5",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0x1d35 as the initial hash value.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x1d35"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_6",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0x29 as a multiplier in the hash computation.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x29"],
      "confidence": 1
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_11(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t h = 0x1d35;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h = (uint32_t)in[i] + h * 0x29;\n  }\n  return (uint64_t)h;\n}"
}
